lat: reddit l-flus l khuya
en: I gave the money back to my brother.

lat: ma redditsh l-ktab l l-mektaba
en: I didn't return the book to the library.

lat: nta redditi s-sarut l mul d-dar
en: You returned the key to the landlord.

lat: nta ma redditish l-jawab l sa7bek
en: You didn't reply to your friend.

lat: nti redditi l-keswa l l-maghaza
en: You (f.) returned the dress to the store.

lat: nti ma redditish l-flus l khtek
en: You (f.) didn't pay back the money to your sister.

lat: huwa redd l-amana l mulha
en: He returned the deposit to its owner.

lat: huwa ma reddsh l-bal l t-triq
en: He didn't pay attention to the road.

lat: hiya reddat l-kora l d-drari
en: She returned the ball to the boys.

lat: hiya ma reddatsh l-jawab l l-mudir
en: She didn't reply to the manager.

lat: 7na reddina s-sel3a l l-biya3
en: We returned the merchandise to the seller.

lat: 7na ma reddinash s-sarut l l-garaj
en: We didn't return the key to the garage.

lat: ntuma redditu l-flus l 3mmi
en: You (pl.) returned the money to my uncle.

lat: ntuma ma redditush l-bal l l-ustad
en: You (pl.) didn't pay attention to the teacher.

lat: huma reddu l-ktub l l-madrassa
en: They returned the books to the school.

lat: huma ma reddush l-flus l n-nas
en: They didn't give back the money to the people.

lat: ana dima kanredd l-bal f t-triq
en: I always pay attention on the road.

lat: ana ma kanreddsh l-flus b z-zerba
en: I don't pay back the money quickly.

lat: nta katredd l-bal mzyan f l-khedma
en: You pay close attention at work.

lat: nta ma katreddsh l-ktab f l-weqt
en: You don't return the book on time.

lat: nti dima katreddi s-sarf l n-nas
en: You (f.) always give the change back to the people.

lat: nti ma katreddish l-bal m3a d-drari
ar: نتي ما كترديش البال مع الدراري
en: You (f.) don't pay attention to the children.

lat: huwa dima kayredd l-jawab b z-zerba
en: He always replies quickly.

lat: huwa ma kayreddsh l-flus l sa7bu
en: He doesn't pay back the money to his friend.

lat: hiya katredd s-sa3a l mulha daba
en: She returns the watch to its owner now.

lat: hiya ma katreddsh l-bal f l-qism
en: She doesn't pay attention in class.

lat: 7na kanreddu l-flus l sh-sherika
en: We return the money to the company.

lat: 7na ma kanreddush t-tumubil f l-weqt
en: We don't return the car on time.

lat: ntuma dima katreddu l-bal l t-tumubilat
en: You (pl.) always pay attention to the cars.

lat: ntuma ma katreddush l-jawab l l-ustad
en: You (pl.) don't reply to the teacher.

lat: huma kayreddu l-krasi l l-bit
en: They return the chairs to the room.

lat: huma ma kayreddush l-flus l mul d-dar
ar: هما ما كيردوش الفلوس لمول الدار
en: They don't pay back the money to the landlord.

lat: ana ghadi nredd l-ktab l sa7bi
en: I'm going to return the book to my friend.

lat: ana ma ghadish nredd l-flus l-yum
ar: أنا ما غاديش نرد الفلوس اليوم
en: I'm not going to return the money today.

lat: nta ghadi tredd t-tumubil ghedda
en: You're going to return the car tomorrow.

lat: nta ma ghadish tredd l-jawab daba
ar: نتا ما غاديش ترد الجواب دابا
en: You're not going to reply right now.

lat: nti ghadi treddi l-keswa l sa7btek
en: You (f.) are going to return the dress to your friend.

lat: nti ma ghadish treddi s-sarut l-yum
ar: نتي ما غاديش تردي الساروت اليوم
en: You (f.) are not going to return the key today.

lat: huwa ghadi yredd l-flus l l-biya3
en: He is going to return the money to the seller.

lat: huwa ma ghadish yredd l-bal f t-triq
ar: هو ما غاديش يرد البال فالطريق
en: He is not going to pay attention on the road.

lat: hiya ghadi tredd l-kora l khuha
en: She is going to return the ball to her brother.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tredd l-ktab l sa7btha
ar: هي ما غاديش ترد الكتاب لصاحبتها
en: She is not going to return the book to her friend.

lat: 7na ghadi nreddu s-sel3a l l-maghaza
en: We are going to return the goods to the store.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nreddu l-flus daba
ar: حنا ما غاديش نردو الفلوس دابا
en: We are not going to return the money now.

lat: ntuma ghadi treddu l-bal f l-khedma
en: You (pl.) are going to pay attention at work.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish treddu s-sarut ghedda
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تردو الساروت غدا
en: You (pl.) are not going to return the key tomorrow.

lat: huma ghadi yreddu l-ktub l l-mudir
en: They are going to return the books to the principal.

lat: huma ma ghadish yreddu l-jawab l-yum
ar: هما ما غاديش يردو الجواب اليوم
en: They are not going to reply today.
